Production logic support for Fallout Shelter. Gained deep insights into mobile pipeline optimization and high-scale production.

aboutDescription: VFX & Technical Artist with over 8 years of experience in Maya and 4 years building high-end stylized solutions. From visual effects and lighting for animated features at Oscar-winning studio PunkRobot ('Brave Cat') to architecting advanced shader systems for AAA-scaled projects. My core expertise lies in Unreal Engine 5 (Niagara, Material Graph) and shader-driven visual solutions, focusing on capturing artistic style through technical innovation. I specialize in bridging the gap between artistic vision and engine constraints, ensuring that every effect is not only visually stunning but also performant across all platforms.
